note: Input bytes interpreted as 13 uint32_t code points, passed directly to idn2_to_ascii_4i
The 13 uint32 code points (including U+12020, U+3220, U+2020) are converted to a UTF-8 string
UTF-8 domain string is looked up with NONTRANSITIONAL flag (set by set_default_flags)
TR46 mapping is applied to the UTF-8 domain; characters like U+3220 are expanded to multiple code points

The length check len2 >= IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH (255) validates code point count but not the resulting UTF-8 byte length; mapped characters expand in UTF-8 encoding and can exceed the fixed-size _mapped buffer
Heap-buffer-overflow: the TR46 mapped output exceeds the stack buffer _mapped[IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH+1] (256 bytes) because multi-byte UTF-8 characters expand beyond the code-point-based length limit
